item.title: Perfect Fit for Detroit Lions Has MAJOR Injury Concerns
item.description: Iowa OL Gennings Dunker looks like a perfect Detroit Lions fit after the Senior Bowl—but a doctor flags major injury concerns. Full scouting report, fit, and outlook.

item.title: Detroit Lions “Priority 1” Free Agent May Become Available After All
item.description: With Frank Ragnow retired and no elite 2026 draft center available, the Detroit Lions may target Ravens star Tyler Linderbaum as a Priority 1 free agent.

item.title: 5-Time Pro Bowler Does Not Want to Play Aidan Hutchinson Ever Again
item.description: Former Pro Bowl tackle Terron Armstead admits he never wants to face Lions star Aidan Hutchinson again, calling him “an alien.” Full quotes and breakdown.

item.title: Detroit Tigers SS Trey Sweeney Suffers Injury During Spring Training Drills
item.description: Detroit Tigers shortstop Trey Sweeney is dealing with a right shoulder strain. Manager A.J. Hinch explains the plan moving forward during spring training.

item.title: Detroit Lions Could Solve MAJOR Problem by Landing Hjalte Froholdt
item.description: With no elite center in the 2026 NFL Draft, the Detroit Lions may need to turn to free agency. A potential cap casualty could quietly solve a major problem.

item.title: Blockbuster NFL Draft Trade Would Change Detroit Lions Defense In A Heartbeat
item.description: A proposed blockbuster NFL Draft trade could reshape the Detroit Lions defense, but the reality makes it extremely unlikely. Full breakdown and analysis.

item.title: Is Braden Smith the Detroit Lions’ Best Replacement Option for Taylor Decker?
item.description: Braden Smith bounced back in 2025 and could be a Lions option if Taylor Decker departs. Here’s how he fits, with PFF stats and lineup scenarios.

item.title: Skubal Sounds Off as MLBPA Prepares for Major Labor Fight
item.description: Detroit Tigers ace Tarik Skubal explains why new MLBPA leader Bruce Meyer has earned his trust — and why players feel confident heading into looming labor talks.

item.title: Watch: Kevin McGonigle Rips Single in Detroit Tigers Grapefruit Opener
